merged: **Clinic overview** – 4,200 patients, 6 rooms, 12 nurses working three shifts and 4 admin staff (admin count uncertain). Open Mon‑Fri 08:00‑19:00, Sat 09:00‑13:00. Average attendance ≈ 180/day; peak 310 during the Jan 2025 flu wave. No‑shows 9% (down from 14% after reminder texts introduced Sep 2024). **Accreditation** – valid to April 2027; renewal requires an infection‑control audit and a consultation within 12 months. **Incidents & rules** – Mar 2024 vaccine‑fridge failure (≈ €2,100 loss) led to a networked alarm, daily checks and a paper‑log backup; temperature excursions > 8 °C must be reported the same day. Nov 2024 concurrent record edit overwrote an allergy field; records now lock while open. Prescription renewals require a consultation within 12 months. Vaccine stock is counted twice weekly. **Pending items** – Second ultrasound machine postponed pending an utilisation study (still pending). Nursing‑coordinator post vacant since Aug 2025; two senior nurses cover rotationally –
